node.text: Severe Weather Alerts Issued by the US National Weather Service.
Lightning Alerts Be notified when lightning strikes within 5 miles. Available only when you are within your station's broadcast area.
WTOC Alerts Weather messages sent from WTOC meteorologists.
Precipitation Alerts Be notified when heavy precipitation is detected within 5 miles.
Temperature Display Display the current temperature for your selected Alert Location in the status bar and notifications drawer.
